findings.evidence: Diff: `namespace Lorentz / namespace Vector` at MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean:31-32 ends at line 53, then `namespace EpsilonEridani` at line 56 holds the constructor; repo precedent for extension files uses the upstream namespace, e.g. `namespace realLorentzTensor` at EpsilonEridani/Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Metrics/LeviCivita.lean:27.
findings.fix: Move the four declarations into `namespace Lorentz.Vector` (drop the `namespace EpsilonEridani` block) and use the unqualified names in `GPD/Kinematics.lean`.
findings.issue: `ofTimeAndTwoSpatial`, `ofTimeAndTwoSpatial_def`, `minkowskiProduct_ofTimeAndTwoSpatial` and `ofTimeAndTwoSpatial_sub_ofTimeAndTwoSpatial` are declared under `namespace EpsilonEridani`, while the other declaration in the same file and the upstream `basis`/`minkowskiProduct_basis_left` API they extend live in `Lorentz.Vector`. Consumers opening `Lorentz.Vector` must still write `EpsilonEridani.ofTimeAndTwoSpatial` (as `Kinematics.lean` does at lines 275, 277, 279, 294), and the constructor is not discoverable next to the vector API it belongs to.

findings.evidence: Diff lines 200-201 (`rw [minkowskiProduct_symm K.delta K.avgMomentum, K.minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_delta_eq_zero] at h`) and 226-227 (`simp only [..., minkowskiProduct_symm K.delta K.avgMomentum, K.minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_delta_eq_zero, ...]`) both develop the reversed orientation manually.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] lemma minkowskiProduct_delta_avgMomentum_eq_zero : ⟪K.delta, K.avgMomentum⟫ₘ = 0 := by rw [minkowskiProduct_symm]; exact K.minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_delta_eq_zero` and use it in `minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_self` and `minkowskiProduct_transverseDelta_self`.
findings.issue: `minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_delta_eq_zero` is `@[simp]` only in the `⟪P, Δ⟫ₘ` orientation, but the file itself needs `⟪Δ, P⟫ₘ = 0` in two proofs and rewrites `minkowskiProduct_symm K.delta K.avgMomentum` by hand each time; downstream users of `transverseDelta`/`avgMomentum` will hit the same gap since simp will not flip the arguments.

summary: The surface is hidden-body and extensional with a complete `_def`/`mem_*_iff` layer and no compatibility artifacts. Two fixable interface issues: the Lorentz-vector constructor is placed in the `EpsilonEridani` namespace instead of `Lorentz.Vector`, and the `⟪Δ, P⟫ₘ = 0` orientation that the file itself uses twice is not a simp lemma.
